label: Earphones or headphones

questions.text: How is the case or headphone charged?
questions.why: Poor chargers can damage the small batteries.

questions.text: Are they used during workouts or in the rain?
questions.why: Sweat and water can get into the speakers and charging contacts.

questions.text: How loud are they usually played?
questions.why: Very loud sound strains the speakers and your hearing.

questions.text: Are they kept in their case when not in use?
questions.why: The case protects against drops and dirt.

questions.text: How often are the ear tips and mesh cleaned?
questions.why: Earwax and dirt block the sound.

questions.text: Have you noticed one side not working, charging problems or crackling?
questions.why: Early signs let you get it checked before a small fault grows.

care_tips.text: Stop using the earphones or case and keep it away from anything that can burn if the battery swells, gets very hot or smells unusual.
care_tips.why: A damaged battery can catch fire.

care_tips.text: Don't open, puncture or crush the battery, and don't use it after a hard fall that dented it.
care_tips.why: Damaged battery cells can overheat or catch fire.

care_tips.text: Switch the earphones or case off and unplug the charger before cleaning it.
care_tips.why: Cleaning a charging device risks a short circuit.

care_tips.text: Charge with a branded charger and cable.
care_tips.why: Cheap chargers can damage the small batteries.

care_tips.text: Wipe off sweat and water, and let them dry before charging.
care_tips.why: Moisture damages the speakers and contacts.
Very loud sound strains the speakers and your hearing.

care_tips.text: Keep them in their case when not in use.
care_tips.why: The case protects against drops and dirt.

care_tips.text: Clean the ear tips and mesh gently with a dry cloth.
care_tips.why: Wax and dirt block the sound.

reminders.text: Clean the ear tips, mesh and charging contacts.
reminders.note: Check your manual for the interval for your model.

risk_factors.reason: Cheap chargers can damage the battery.
